title: eXoZymes to Host Third Quarter 2026 update Conference Call on Thursday, November 19, 2026
summary: Los Angeles, CA -- November 12, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer in AI-enhanced biomanufacturing enabling commercial-scale production of rare natural molecules and novel medicines - announced the plan to host a webinar on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss its results for the third quarter 2026. A press release detailing these results will be issued prior to the call.
body_markdown: **Los Angeles, CA -- November 12, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”)** **- a pioneer in AI-enhanced biomanufacturing enabling commercial-scale production of rare natural molecules and novel medicines -** **announced the plan to host a webinar on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss its results for the third quarter 2026. A press release detailing these results will be issued prior to the call.**
